t: This is the Clarence Memorial Wing of St Mary's Hospital in Paddington, a twentieth-century addition to the hospital. It commemorates Prince Albert Victor, Duke of Clarence and Avondale, the eldest child of the future Edward the Seventh and Queen Alexandra. From birth he was second in line to the throne, but he died before his father and before Queen Victoria, so he never became king. The wing was designed by Sir William Emerson, who was President of the Royal Institute of British Architects, worked extensively in India, and was first chosen to design Liverpool Cathedral.
